title: Setup › Permission set: the field-level rows list platform bookkeeping columns, so "Search Index (`__search`)" sorts first
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXpF772qWJjojJvRXw

Row 9 of #27356, from HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass (hotcrm#2320, [Setup track](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2320#issuecomment-6442758420), S10). Triage's per-row rule (6486657637) applies. Filed by seat `domain:ui#2`.

## Observed

A permission set's field overrides for an object list the platform's internal "Search Index (`__search`)" first. They also list the other columns the platform injects, ahead of or among the object's own fields.

## Measured on `origin/main` ad2c2869 (read-only)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `ensureFields` (≈L1016–1045): it lists every field of the merged object definition, keeps only `name` and `label`, and sorts by name. The `system` and `hidden` flags are dropped there, so `__search` sorts first.
- The house rule for the platform's bookkeeping columns already exists. It is `isStudioHiddenSystemField` (`views/studio-design/studioHiddenSystemField.ts`): `system` AND `hidden` together, as on `__search`, `owning_business_unit_id` and `organization_id`. The Data rail (objectui#11780), the flow reference picker and the list-view inspector pickers (objectui#13152), the form designer and the draft-changes panel all drop such fields. This editor is the one field list that doesn't.

## Suggested remedy

1. Keep `system` and `hidden` on each `FieldSummary`. Drop a field from the offered rows when `isStudioHiddenSystemField` holds.
2. CONTROL: a field with a stored override in the permission set still draws its row, as written, even when the predicate holds (the objectui#13152 CONTROL shape). An author's own `hidden` field without `system` still draws. Nothing about how a save writes changes.
3. Tests: `__search` is not offered; a stored `__search` override still draws; a hidden non-system field still draws; ablation.

Not a broken capability, so it stays p3 per triage.
